purpose: Measure singing activity separately from lexical correspondence; no automatic acceptance, rejection, endpoint repair, or timestamp change

gates.checkpoint_permission: Explicit checkpoint-scoped evaluation permission or license required; source-code license alone is insufficient for this study

resource_limits.substantial_new_downloads: Require explicit approval; previous ceilings are not a renewed allowance

gates.execution: One checkpoint only; isolated CPU environment; local inputs; no renderer or schema change

criteria_classification: Proposed engineering screen, not validated product acceptance or a population guarantee. All criteria required; no aggregate score compensates for a failed gap or new-singer stratum.

partitions.development: At least two independently annotated accompanied excerpts from one singer excluded from validation and final testing
partitions.validation: Separate singer and at least two excerpts; select any permitted calibration once, then freeze
partitions.held_out: At least two further singers and four accompanied excerpts, each 20–60 seconds; at least one singer absent from the historical alignment corpus; no singer overlap with development or validation
partitions.language: English and Japanese where lawful independently annotated mixtures exist; isolated PJS is an auxiliary stratum and cannot establish Japanese mixture performance
partitions.features: Require sustained vowels, short phrases, audible pauses, reverb, prominent instruments and at least 20 clear onsets and offsets plus 10 nonvocal gaps across held-out data
partitions.manifest_status: Not frozen: qualifying new singer/audio permissions and verified vocal labels have not been acquired. Do not run candidate inference before freezing identities, hashes, regions, singer groups, and roles.

annotation.independence: Listener or published human VAD annotation, verified without candidate, CTC, or forced-alignment output
annotation.positive: Audible sung vocal production, including unvoiced sung consonants and sustained vowels; tag lead, backing, overlapping, humming and ad-lib separately
annotation.negative: Verified absence of sung production; annotate instrumental and silence strata separately
annotation.unknown: Breaths, spoken interjections, indistinguishable reverberation tails, and disputed boundaries are explicit unknown regions; do not score as negatives
annotation.uncertainty: Store earliest/latest plausible onset and offset. Score boundary error as distance outside that interval; report unknown duration and sensitivity with strict/permissive annotation masks
annotation.verification: Second independent review of all held-out boundaries; unresolved disagreements remain unknown

metrics.frame_grid: Common 10-ms centers; use exact rational comparisons with native model samples; no video-frame rounding; unknown centers excluded
metrics.counts: TP=predicted vocal/reference vocal, FP=predicted vocal/reference nonvocal, TN=predicted nonvocal/reference nonvocal, FN=predicted nonvocal/reference vocal
metrics.definitions: Precision=TP/(TP+FP); recall=TP/(TP+FN); F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); FPR=FP/(FP+TN); FNR=FN/(FN+TP). Undefined denominators remain unavailable.
metrics.duration: Exact intersection/union arithmetic on half-open intervals after excluding unknown support; report reference duration covered independently of grid counts
metrics.interval: One-to-one maximum total overlap pairing with IoU >= 0.5; ties resolved chronologically. Report unmatched reference and predicted intervals; merging two phrases cannot count as two matches.
metrics.boundaries: Onset and offset median, linearly interpolated p95, maximum and >500-ms count for matched uncensored boundaries, with unmatched counts alongside; never use independent phase registration
metrics.gaps: Active-duration fraction per annotated instrumental gap and count with any activation >=100 ms; separate pauses and silence
metrics.uncertainty: Report per-recording and per-singer results plus recording-cluster bootstrap intervals only if enough independent recordings; frame counts are correlated, not independent sample sizes

inference.first_run: Pinned documented default preprocessing and postprocessing before any calibration
inference.veracity_documented_recipe: 22,050 Hz; 1,024-sample magnitude STFT; 315-sample hop; 80 mel bands; log scaling; 115-frame context; default evaluation median window 56 frames; supplied-checkpoint documented threshold 0.51. No silent replacement with unsmoothed 0.5.
inference.calibration: At most thresholds 0.41/0.51/0.61 and smoothing 0/28/56 frames on development/validation only; preserve default results. No minimum-duration rules or recording-specific offsets.
inference.sensitivity: After primary scoring, fixed gain +/-6 dB, alternate resampling implementation and one AAC encode/decode; report changes without selecting winners on held-out material
inference.reproducibility: Pin input, source, checkpoint, configuration and dependency hashes. Preserve native rational grid; scores are not calibrated probabilities. Exclude runtime/memory only from semantic equality.

incremental_analysis: Standalone VAD first. Then compare unexplained vocal intervals with original aligned intervals without changing estimates. Backing voices and ad-libs need not correspond to supplied lead lyrics. Correct occurrence, repetitions and different words with equal vocal support remain unresolved. Keep lexical decisions separate; no fitted ensemble.
